title: Lay Down and Rest
location: Kirkos, 1 Little Green Street, D07 K744
notes:
Lay Down and Rest is a theatre piece comprising music by me and video design by Jack Leitch. It is about time, love, and memory.

We’ll do it on the 16th of July at Kirkos, 1 Little Green Street.

Free but ticketed. Link in bio!
